items.description: WhatsApp is developing a new privacy control called Restricted Chat that will keep selected conversations accessible only from a user’s primary mobile phone. The feature is designed to prevent protected chats from syncing to WhatsApp Web, desktop sessions, and secondary phones linked to the same account.
